$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a house-painter content seed (Shotgun Color Co., New Orleans), a coral brand, and the paintchip register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: House painting
description: A house painter's site in Swiss color blocks: a split hero whose photograph bleeds off the page, a wall-to-wall row of paint chips that each lead to a quote, starting prices, a draggable before/after, a live open/closed badge with click-to-call, color-walk booking, and a quote form with a pick-your-color field — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this trade's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Color walk
types.description: An hour at your house with Dolores and the deck, free — test patches, the afternoon light, and the historic-district rules for your address.

types.name: Interior estimate
types.description: A walk through the rooms: walls, ceilings, plaster repairs, and trim, measured for a written quote.

theme.$comment: Coral as the brand: on the paintchip register the accent is the chip you press — the asks, the stripe under the headline's last word, the kicker chips — while the deck's own colors live in the content (palette), so a rebrand never repaints the product. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the centered masthead sets the wordmark like the name on a fan deck's spine, apart from the landscaping remix's full-width band — the nav-variety audit spreads the services family across the vocabulary. mode light opens on the paper stock (the base contractor opens dark, and theme merges shallowly).

landing.$comment: The pin: the paintchip register and the storefront home re-cut for a color trade — the split hero (live badge, quote + call, the credit line), the color deck straight under it as a wall-to-wall row of chips (the seed's palette), services with starting prices, the before/after, the neighbors, the neighborhoods, and the closing banner. The seed leaves the coastal-builder lists (ticker, build log, materials board) empty, so those sections are never built. The other pages keep the base's skeletons; resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
